title: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: A customer-embedded engineer who converts ambiguous, high-value workflows into secure, adopted, supportable production systems and reusable product learning.

includes: Lead the evidence and engineering chain from workflow discovery through production adoption, stabilization, handoff, and field learning.
Build and verify production behavior across customer interfaces, data, controls, operating constraints, and ownership boundaries.
Prepare decision-quality evidence and escalate formal risk, safety, privacy, legal, and business decisions to accountable owners.
excludes: Act as legal counsel, independent auditor, safety authority, privacy officer, or unilateral security and business risk acceptor.
Own general account health, commercial pricing, renewals, enterprise transformation, or every component in the customer environment.
Represent the provisional Komal publication domains as an Abhyaas certification standard before cross-repo reconciliation.

competencies.title: Role, ethics, and outcome ownership
competencies.description: Hold the deployed outcome while respecting authority, safety, and adjacent-role boundaries.

objectives.statement: Define and lead a bounded production outcome without claiming authority assigned to another role.

competencies.title: Workflow discovery and domain learning
competencies.description: Build evidence-backed models of work, users, decisions, data, exceptions, incentives, and failure cost.

objectives.statement: Discover and validate the real workflow while distinguishing observation, report, inference, and unresolved evidence.

competencies.title: Outcome contracts, scope, and sequencing
competencies.description: Define success and guardrails, control scope, expose dependencies, and sequence a safe path to value.

objectives.statement: Contract measurable outcomes and select the smallest safe production path with explicit decisions and exit criteria.

competencies.title: Architecture and customer integration
competencies.description: Define system, interface, deployment, and ownership boundaries under customer constraints.

objectives.statement: Design implementable system and integration boundaries with explicit trust, failure, and ownership semantics.

competencies.title: Production engineering
competencies.description: Build, test, review, diagnose, and maintain production-grade application and automation code.

objectives.statement: Implement and diagnose a representative end-to-end path with safe failures, reviewable code, and support evidence.

competencies.title: Data contracts and quality
competencies.description: Integrate bounded data paths with explicit semantics, lineage, validation, and exception handling.

objectives.statement: Design semantic data and interface contracts that handle invalid, missing, late, duplicate, and ambiguous states.

competencies.title: AI and model integration and evaluation
competencies.description: Use AI conditionally, measure behavior, define controls, and connect model quality to workflow risk.

objectives.statement: Select and bound AI behavior with task-specific evaluations, deterministic controls, and accountable human decisions.

competencies.title: Security, privacy, governance, and compliance
competencies.description: Discover risk, design controls, produce evidence, respect formal authority, and escalate responsibly.

objectives.statement: Integrate security and governance evidence into delivery while routing formal decisions to accountable owners.

competencies.title: Verification, reliability, and operations
competencies.description: Make production claims testable through acceptance evidence, telemetry, objectives, recovery, and operations.

objectives.statement: Verify, observe, release, recover, and stabilize the deployment against explicit user and system promises.

competencies.title: Rollout, adoption, enablement, and handoff
competencies.description: Cross the production threshold safely and leave a used, stable, supportable system.

objectives.statement: Prove safe rollout and representative use, then transfer operation, support, access, and change ownership.

competencies.title: Field learning and product leverage
competencies.description: Convert repeated evidence into reusable components, playbooks, and product feedback without premature abstraction.

objectives.statement: Separate customer-specific work from reusable product leverage using evidence, isolation, and a validation path.

competencies.title: Engagement leadership and portfolio judgment
competencies.description: Align decisions, manage ambiguity and tradeoffs, communicate evidence, and lead multiple deployments.

objectives.statement: Lead and communicate deployment decisions at multiple altitudes with explicit confidence, authority, and escalation.
